About Us
Building healthcare applications is complex and time-consuming, and we know this firsthand - we've been creating custom health IT solutions since 2004.
In 2012, we discovered the FHIR standard and quickly recognized its potential to simplify healthcare software development and reduce costs.
After successfully applying FHIR in multiple projects, we used our years of experience to build Aidbox - a FHIR backend platform that helps organizations develop advanced healthcare solutions faster.
With over two decades in health IT, we continue to lead the way in building an open, connected healthcare ecosystem that fosters innovation and collaboration.
[Contact Us](https://www.health-samurai.io/company#contact-form)
## Media Mentions
flexpa.com nature.com HL7 AI Challenge seeyoudoc.com
### Health Samurai Takes 2nd Place in Flexpa Research
Health Samurai took 2nd place among vendors in Flexpa's research. This recognition highlights our steady work in patient access APIs and healthcare interoperability, as we continue building practical and reliable solutions for the industry.
[Learn more](https://www.flexpa.com/blog/may-2025-state-of-the-payer-patient-access-api-report)
![May 2025 State of the Payer Patient Access API Report](https://www.health-samurai.io/assets/images/flexpa-may-2025-patient-access-api-report.avif?v=gg9.mugu)
### Aidbox Powered Real-World SQL on FHIR Validation
The SQL on FHIR study showed that tabular FHIR views can run portably across different technology stacks. For the PostgreSQL-based implementation, the authors used Aidbox FHIR Server because it already supports executing views over FHIR datasets and materializing them through the FHIR API.
[Learn more](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41746-025-01708-w)
![Video thumbnail](https://i.ytimg.com/vi/Z6YvmE6opMY/maxresdefault.jpg)
### Health Samurai wins HL7 AI Challenge
Health Samurai is proud to announce that our team has been recognized at the HL7 Global AI Challenge 2025, a competition highlighting how artificial intelligence can advance interoperability, clinical workflows, and patient care.
[Learn more](https://blog.hl7.org/hl7-international-announces-winners-of-global-ai-challenge-showcasing-standards-based-innovation-in-healthcare)
![HL7 International 2025 AI Challenge Awardee medal](https://www.health-samurai.io/assets/images/hl7-ai-challenge-2025-medal.avif?v=1rgu.mug)
### SeeYouDoc Publishes Guide to EMR Integration with Aidbox
SeeYouDoc published a practical guide to integrating an EMR with Aidbox as a FHIR server for referral workflows. The article walks through setup, OAuth configuration, and ServiceRequest-based data exchange for interoperable referrals.
[Learn more](https://www.seeyoudoc.com/articles/how-to-integrate-with-aidbox-fhir-server-as-emr-provider)
![EMR integration with Aidbox FHIR server](https://www.health-samurai.io/assets/aidbox/use-cases/ehr.svg?v=1ycw.mug)
